needs_atom.missing: 'You may reveal an Angel card, a Demon card, and/or a Dragon card from among them and put them into your hand': a partition of ONE look window into per-category picks (at most one Angel, one Demon and one Dragon). A single ONE_OF has one filter and one count, so FOr(Angel, Demon, Dragon) with up to 3 lets three Angels go to hand (stronger than printed); three sequential ONE_OFs do not work because run_atom closes the look window after the first MOVE_ZONE (verbs.py run_atom: look_window = () for non-look verbs), so the next pick sees only the library's top card. Needs a multi-category partition pick (or a look window that persists across the sentence's picks).
